name: Hatfall
author: Addicting Games
description: HATFALL is a high-energy game of skill and hat-wearing born from Zero Punctuation, the hit online video series from The Escapist, created by the man behind ZP, Ben 'Yahtzee' Croshaw. When Yahtzee finds that his hat has gone missing theres only one option: collect as many hats as you possibly can. (Note: For best gameplay, be sure to update your browser to the latest version!)
